BETA TEST AGREEMENT

This Beta Test Agreement is between Lumen Analytics, Inc. ("Company") and Harcastle Foods Co. ("Tester").

1. Beta Product. Company will give Tester access to a pre-release version of its forecasting product for testing.

2. Feedback. Tester will report bugs and give feedback, which Company may use freely.

3. Confidentiality. The beta product and its features are confidential.

4. No Warranty. The beta product is provided as is and may contain errors.
